week4_results_status: VALID; frozen evaluation reported without test-based tuning
feature_freeze_reason: UCI states all non-target attributes are first-nine-month aggregates.

Status.evidence: UCI states every non-target attribute is aggregated in the first nine months, before the month-12 churn label.

Customer Value.evidence: UCI explicitly lists Customer Value among the non-target attributes and states every non-target attribute is aggregated in the first nine months, before the month-12 churn label.
Customer Value.limitation: The exact formula and component fields are not published; formula unknown is a documentation limitation, not evidence of leakage.

preprocessing.fit_scope: fold-train for CV; train for validation; train+validation only after freeze for final fit

selection_source: train-only 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; validation used only for capacity thresholds
threshold_source: validation probabilities from the candidate fitted on train only
threshold_refit_protocol: threshold selected on train-fit validation probabilities; final candidate then refitted on train+validation; the same absolute threshold was applied to test
threshold_validity_after_final_fit: VALID AS FROZEN; validation target coverage was approximately 10/20/30%, while realized coverage after refit is not guaranteed to be exact

primary_threshold.reason: Care team can contact approximately 20% of customers; selected on validation before test.

test_contamination_risk: NONE FOR THE REPORTED FROZEN EVALUATION; threshold capacity after refit is approximate, which is a protocol limitation rather than test leakage
baseline_pr_auc_note: For a degenerate constant score, trapezoidal PR_AUC is inflated by endpoint geometry and must not be interpreted as ranking ability; AP equals prevalence and ROC_AUC=0.5 are the clearer references.

post_test_audit.changes: status, provenance and interpretation metadata only; model, features, thresholds and test metrics were not changed; test was not rerun

final_correction.basis: UCI explicitly places Customer Value among non-target attributes aggregated in the first-nine-month observation window; missing formula retained as a limitation, not treated as leakage evidence
